verdict.rationale: Bulk processing is a fair axis for a document-parsing API. The parse examples list includes "batch processing" (llamaparse-docs-52), Classify configurations can be reused by ID across multiple jobs (llamaparse-docs-39), and webhooks notify on job completion instead of polling (llamaparse-docs-6), which supports running many async jobs. However, batch support appears only as a one-line example title with no documented mechanics. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints or SDK methods, limits and concurrency details for many-item jobs, bulk support across Extract/Split/Classify, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch workflows.
